videos.headline: “I thought I could handle the adjuster myself.”
“The first offer was insulting. They kept going.”

reviews.author: Howard
reviews.quote: It was a pleasure to have this law firm represent me. From the first day I walked in their office it was a warm welcome. During my representation they were there for me, always calling to remind me of appointments and preparing me as well. I would recommend them to anyone who needs representation. I am extremely pleased with their performance. The staff was fantastic.

reviews.author: Menache R.
reviews.quote: I found The Law Office of Cohen & Jaffe online by the reviews, and I will say the reviews were spot on. They are excellent, I worked with Steve on my Mom’s case and Steve and his staff were outstanding. They constantly kept in touch with updates and were always available to answer any questions we had. I would highly recommend Cohen & Jaffe you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Patty R.
reviews.quote: I had a great experience with this law firm, from easy communication via email, text and phone calls. Each member of the team helping me, especially Trisha, was very kind, took their time to answer my questions. I recommend utilizing their skills if ever needed.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: I can’t begin to find the words to describe how beyond grateful I am to have found this law firm. My attorney Richard Jaffe was spectacular. He explained everything, he answered when I called, and he never once made me feel like a file on a desk.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: They explained every step in plain English before it happened, so I was never sitting at home wondering what was going on with my own case. Calls came back the same day, every time.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: The insurance company acted like nothing happened to me. Cohen & Jaffe took the whole thing off my shoulders and kept pushing long after I would have given up on my own.

reviews.author: Denise M.
reviews.quote: I fell in a supermarket and assumed nothing could be done because I was embarrassed. They took it seriously from the first phone call, got the incident report and the footage, and handled the store’s insurer for me.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: I was out of work for eight months. They advanced every cost, and I never once had to write a check while the case was open. That is the only reason I could afford to see it through.

reviews.author: Robert A.
reviews.quote: Richard handled my deposition prep himself and walked me through every question I might get. When the day came I was not nervous, because nothing surprised me.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: A lot of firms would not return my call once they heard motorcycle. These guys did not blink. They understood the bike, the road, and what actually happened out there.

reviews.author: Yolanda P.
reviews.quote: They spoke to my husband and me in Spanish, explained the paperwork line by line, and never made us feel rushed. That mattered more than I can explain.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: Every update came before I had to ask for it. In two years I do not think I ever called and wondered where things stood.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: They had a physician review my records before they told me I had a case. No promises up front, just an honest answer, which is what I wanted.

reviews.author: Anthony D.
reviews.quote: The first offer was a fraction of my medical bills. They said no and kept working. What we ended with was not close to what the adjuster wanted me to take.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: They handled the hardest year of our family’s life with real decency. We were never a case number to anyone in that office.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: A driver door-ed me and left. They tracked down the vehicle and the policy, and I did not have to make a single one of those calls myself.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: We brought them a folder of paperwork we did not understand. They read all of it, told us what it meant, and told us the truth about our options.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: I was worried about my immigration status and whether making a claim would hurt me. They answered that question honestly on the first call, at no charge.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: My husband’s injury was not visible, so the insurer treated it like it was not real. They brought in the right experts and made a record that could not be dismissed.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: Steve met me at my house because I could not drive. I did not expect a lawyer to do that.

reviews.author: Client
reviews.quote: Straight answers, no exaggerated promises, and they never once made me feel like I was bothering them by calling.
